story.title: A friendly 5K morning connected to Azalea Festival and a local scholarship fund.
paragraphs: The Azalea Festival 5k Run and Walk brings runners and walkers to Doodle Park for a chip-timed 5K that starts and finishes in Pickens.
The Azalea Festival 5k Run and Walk is the third race in the Pickens County 5k Race Series; runners who complete three of the four races receive series swag and are eligible for series awards.
Proceeds support the Beverly Smith Scholarship Fund through the Pickens Women’s Association, a nonprofit civic organization serving the Pickens community.
story.quote: You can make a difference in the lives of people in the Pickens community and have fun doing it!

charity.name: Beverly Smith Scholarship Fund

charity.description: Race proceeds support the Beverly Smith Scholarship Fund. The Pickens Women’s Association describes the scholarship as honoring Beverly M. Smith and supporting a female graduate from Pickens High School who exhibits exceptional leadership and civic skills.
